annotations.title: Format a fax number for sending

description: Turn a fax number into the international form FaxUp uses and check it can actually take a fax (right country, not a mobile or premium line). Read-only; sends nothing.

country.description: ISO country code for a number given without "+", e.g. "GB".

to_number.description: Fax number in international form, e.g. "+1 202 555 0143" or "+44 20 7123 4567". Without a "+" it is read as US/Canada, or as `country`.

name: format_fax_number
title: Format a fax number for sending
